os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
pairs=[{"input":G['Demo pair %d input'%k],"output":G['Demo pair %d output'%k]} for k in (1,2,3)]

src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    vals=[v for r in g for v in r]
    bg=max(set(vals),key=vals.count)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v==bg or v==0: continue
            for di,dj in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
                pi,pj=i-di,j-dj
                if 0<=pi<h and 0<=pj<w and g[pi][pj]==v: continue
                cells=[]; a,b=i,j
                while 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and g[a][b]==v:
                    cells.append((a,b)); a+=di; b+=dj
                if len(cells)<2: continue
                a,b=cells[0][0]-di,cells[0][1]-dj
                while 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and g[a][b]==bg:
                    out[a][b]=v; a-=di; b-=dj
                a,b=cells[-1][0]+di,cells[-1][1]+dj
                while 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and g[a][b]==bg:
                    out[a][b]=v; a+=di; b+=dj
    return out
'''
open('programs/task-7cb824c2.py','w').write(src)
